Hi Elena — thanks, and appreciate the populated sheet. Quick answers below; full notes attached.

Summary answers (short):
- Conditional holdback: 10% is held per milestone. Standard cadence is quarterly releases aligned to milestone acceptance. If Stratus provides written acceptance within the quarter, we release on the subsequent invoice.
- Remittance: Use the SEPA IBAN in the Signed SOW for all EUR wires. The alternative account was for USD routing only — I'll flag that on the schedule to avoid double-posts.

Operational notes (attached playbook):
- We will generate invoices on the 1st of each quarter starting 2027-10-01, except the initial upfront which is invoiced on 2027-08-01.
- Holdback reconciliation will be a separate line item titled ‘Holdback Release’ so your AP team can apply against the liability account.
- For VAT: Redwood will supply a VAT validation certificate and reverse-charge notes where applicable; please confirm Stratus' VAT registration number on the schedule.

Next steps:
1) I updated your sheet and attached the Redwood AP routing snippet (see Stratus_Invoice_Schedule_v1.xlsx).
2) Lauren will send our remittance confirmation and SOW reference for DocuSign.
3) Marcus will follow up with legal/finance if you need a custom invoice template.

Cheers,
